description: Full detail for one procurement forecast entry by its APFS number (e.g. "F2026074190") or numeric id, as returned by forecast_search. Adds the complete requirement narrative, period of performance, place of performance, contract vehicle and type, competition status, and the requirements/contracting/small-business contacts with e-mail and phone. Keyless.
